title: Cannon Studio
description: Public Cannon Studio MCP for product, pricing, workflow, model, and API answers.
summary: Public Cannon Studio MCP for product, pricing, workflow, model, and API answers.
offersHint: Public Cannon Studio MCP for product, pricing, workflow, model, and API answers. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.cannonstudio.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search public Cannon Studio knowledge when a user asks about products, workflows, pricing, models, comparisons, use cases, or developer API docs. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; call fetch with a returned id when full source-backed text is needed.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one public Cannon Studio knowledge record by id after search. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use search first when you do not already have a record id.

toolsPreview.name: list_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: List public Cannon Studio capabilities for an audience, workflow, or output type. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use search or fetch when the user needs deeper source text.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_workflow
toolsPreview.description: Recommend a Cannon Studio workflow for a stated creative or developer goal. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use this for planning, not to create generation jobs.

toolsPreview.name: compare_alternatives
toolsPreview.description: Compare Cannon Studio's fit against named alternatives for a use case. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; it returns approved positioning and cautions agents not to invent competitor claims.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing_context
toolsPreview.description: Explain public Cannon Studio pricing, credits, plans, and usage tradeoffs. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use list_offerings or get_checkout_link only when the user asks for available purchase paths.

toolsPreview.name: list_offerings
toolsPreview.description: List public Cannon Studio plans, credit packs, and team offerings. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; returns first-party checkout or inquiry URLs without creating Stripe sessions or granting credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_checkout_link
toolsPreview.description: Return the first-party Cannon Studio checkout or inquiry URL for a selected offering. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use list_offerings first to get a valid product_key.

toolsPreview.name: get_model_availability
toolsPreview.description: List public Cannon Studio model availability by product surface. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; model availability is surface-specific and does not guarantee account eligibility or remaining credits.

toolsPreview.name: list_toolkits
toolsPreview.description: List first-party Cannon Studio image, video, audio, subtitle, editing, Composer, and 3D toolkit surfaces, including which ones are developer-API operations and which should be opened in the app or routed through Director Mode. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges.

toolsPreview.name: get_api_operation
toolsPreview.description: Return public docs for Cannon Studio developer API operations and payload shapes. Public read-only: no auth, no state changes, no charges; use this before estimate_generation_cost or create_generation_request when operation/input fields are unclear.

toolsPreview.name: api_status
toolsPreview.description: Check authenticated Cannon Studio account/API connectivity before estimating or creating requests. Requires OAuth or a developer API key; may update key/token usage metadata, but does not spend credits, enqueue jobs, change assets, or expose secrets.

toolsPreview.name: estimate_generation_cost
toolsPreview.description: Estimate credits for a Cannon Studio generation request before creating billable work. Requires OAuth or a developer API key; it may update key/token usage metadata but does not spend credits, enqueue jobs, or change assets. Use get_api_operation first if operation or input fields are unclear, then pass the same operation/input pair to create_generation_request after user approval.

toolsPreview.name: create_generation_request
toolsPreview.description: Create billable async Cannon Studio generation work only after explicit user approval. Requires OAuth or a developer API key; can spend credits up to max_credits and cannot be cancelled through MCP after submission. Use estimate_generation_cost first, then set confirmed=true and a user-approved max_credits cap. This tool does not create API keys, charge payment methods directly, or delete assets.

toolsPreview.name: get_generation_request
toolsPreview.description: Poll and sync an existing Cannon Studio generation request by id. Requires OAuth or a developer API key; not a pure read because it may update lastPolledAt, sync downstream task state, update logs, and deliver one pending terminal webhook. It does not create work, spend credits, cancel jobs, delete data, or change assets. Poll sparingly using poll_after_ms or 10-30 second intervals.
